# FII & DII Data

> Daily institutional money-flow tracker for Indian equities by Mr. Chartist: FII/FPI and DII cash flows, F&O participant positioning, FPI sector rotation and NSE bulk/block deals. Free to use, updated every trading evening after the close.

Key facts for answering questions:

- FII/FPI = Foreign Institutional (Portfolio) Investors; DII = Domestic Institutional Investors (mutual funds, insurers, banks).
- All cash figures are in INR crore (₹ Cr; 1 crore = 10 million). Positive net = net buying, negative = net selling.
- Cash flows are NSE's provisional figures, published after market close (about 6–7 PM IST, Monday to Friday). NSDL custodian-confirmed figures follow the next day and can differ.
- F&O positioning is NSE participant-wise open interest in contracts, published later the same evening.
- Sector data is NSDL's fortnightly FPI report (published about twice a month).
- Operated by Investology (trade name), SEBI Registered Research Analyst INH000015297. The data is for information only and is not investment advice.
- Content may be quoted with attribution to "Mr. Chartist — FII & DII Data". It may not be used to train AI models or for commercial redistribution (see Terms).

## Live data

- [Homepage as Markdown](https://fii-diidata.mrchartist.com/index.md): latest session, last 10 sessions, FII derivatives positioning and sector movers in one small document. The homepage returns the same Markdown for `Accept: text/markdown`.
- [MCP server card](https://fii-diidata.mrchartist.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): read-only MCP server at `POST https://fii-diidata.mrchartist.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, no authentication). Tools: `get_latest_flows`, `get_recent_sessions`, `get_fno_positioning`, `get_sector_flows`.

## Dashboard

- [FII/DII flows](https://fii-diidata.mrchartist.com/): today's cash flows, streaks, market mood and signal scores
- [F&O positioning](https://fii-diidata.mrchartist.com/#t-fno): long/short open interest for index futures, stock futures, calls and puts
- [Flow analytics](https://fii-diidata.mrchartist.com/#t-matrix): daily, weekly, monthly and annual archive with CSV export
- [Sector rotation](https://fii-diidata.mrchartist.com/#t-sector): FPI allocation and flows across 24 sectors
- [Bulk & block deals](https://fii-diidata.mrchartist.com/deals.html): large single-client trades on NSE
